headline.title: Bomb hoaxes hit at least 27 European flights in one day
headline.quip: Fighter jets, diversions, a plane stopped mid-taxi, and nothing on board anywhere. European airspace, held hostage by an inbox.
headline.summary: At least 27 flights across Europe received bomb hoaxes in a single day; counts range from 25 to 27. French jets intercepted an Aer Lingus Dublin–Rome flight and took it to Évreux, a London–Sofia flight diverted to Plovdiv, Spain received three emailed threats in under 20 minutes, and a LOT flight was halted while taxiing. Nothing was found.

also.title: A nationwide strike closes a third of French high schools
also.summary: A nationwide strike in France closed or disrupted about a third of high schools, disrupted public transport in some areas and closed the Eiffel Tower. Turnout estimates ranged from more than 600,000 (Interior Ministry) to about 1.6 million (CGT).
